name: Rugged Detective (Scout Archetype)
body:
Scouts sometimes operate in urban environments where their skills and mobility can make them excellent investigators and spies.

Cunning Grit (Ex)

The rugged detective uses their Intelligence instead of their Wisdom for their grit pool and any DCs or effects of their deeds.

This ability modifies grit and deeds, but does not prevent abilities from replacing those abilities.

Blend in the Crowd (Ex)

Starting at 4th level, a rugged detective leaves no trail in urban surroundings and cannot be tracked and Diplomacy checks to gather information about them fail. They may choose to leave a trail if so desired.

This ability replaces trackless step.

Unhindered Movement (Ex)

Beginning at 6th level, a rugged detective is not slowed by difficult terrain caused by urban rubble, stairs, uneven surfaces like the roof of a building or crowds.

This ability does not let the rugged detective move more quickly through terrain that requires a Climb or Swim check to navigate, nor can they move more quickly through terrain that has been magically manipulated to impede motion.

This ability replaces unhindered steps.

The following deeds replace deeds normally gained by the scout.

Practiced Guile (Ex)

A scout can spend 1 grit point when they make a Bluff, Disable Device, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth check to roll 1d6 and add the result to the check. They can do this after they make the check but before the result is revealed. If the result of the d6 roll is a natural 6, they roll another 1d6 and add it to the check. They can continue to do this as long as they roll natural 6s, up to a number of times equal to their Dexterity modifier (minimum 1).

This replaces the covert finesse deed normally gained at 1st level.

Collar the Culprit (Ex)

Beginning with 3rd level, while the rugged detective has at least 1 grit point, whenever they attack with a weapon they may choose to have all damage dealt by the attack, including precision and energy damage, be non-lethal. In addition, when the rugged detective scores a critical hit with a non-lethal attack they may expend 1 grit point to increase the critical multiplier of the weapon by 1.

This deed replaces the trick shot deed normally gained at 3rd level.
